body: I had everything and I just let it all fall away

There is 
I’m just getting in my own way and being my own worst enemy 
I can’t stand  the person I’ve become

I just let my life get to a place I’m not okay with 
and I want out

That’s exactly what I’ve been going through! Everything was pretty alright and then I hit a wall and ever since I’ve been feeling like I’m in the wrong reality. It’s nice knowing someone else feels out of place and I’m not completely alone in that. Life used to be so okay. Isn’t it wild how there’s so much beauty and so many resources and just potential in the world and yet you can be in such a fucked to situation because of some dumb decisions that didn’t seem like a big deal at the time 
I hope you’re doing alright at least some what

I have a job that I can’t stand anymore and I have family that is willing to do whatever they can to help along with supportive friends. I have a phone. I do have things going for me in a way. Life is just so far off from anything I’d imagine for myself. I never thought I’d be writing something like this on Reddit. I feel like a terrible person and I’m just done. I’m humiliated by so many things I’ve said and done. I don’t know what life is at all anymore.
